ruleDefinitions.name: Renamed ZOHO Dctask64 Execution
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects a renamed "dctask64.exe" execution, a signed binary by ZOHO Corporation part of ManageEngine Endpoint Central.
This binary can be abused for DLL injection, arbitrary command and process execution.

sequences.query: (process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=6834B1B94E49701D77CCB3C0895E1AFD.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=1BB6F93B129F398C7C4A76BB97450BBA.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=FAA2AC19875FADE461C8D89DCF2710A3.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=F1039CED4B91572AB7847D26032E6BBF.*")) AND  NOT (process_path = RGX("\\\\dctask64\\\.exe$"))
